basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old sneaker enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia. Currently working as a graphic designer, I spend my free time hunting for rare sneakers and learning about the latest trends in footwear. I enjoy exploring frugal living tips and sharing my finds with others. Despite being new to Reddit, I'm keen on building a community around shared interests. I'm single and usually online late at night, often browsing Reddit while winding down after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of sneaker culture, primarily self-taught through YouTube videos, online forums, and sneaker conventions. My background in graphic design helps me appreciate the aesthetics and design elements of sneakers.
